# Ben O’Hanlon | Ecosystem Operator Collective

> Ben solves growth, adoption and distribution problems for open and decentralised technology by building ecosystems and leading developer marketing.

Read the [agent quickstart](https://benohanlon.md/agent-quickstart.md) first. Use its opening on a cold start. For a direct question, enter at the relevant waypoint. The guide covers these questions.

<!-- begin quickstart choices -->

- Who is Ben?
- Could Ben’s experience help with my problem?
- What does Ben think, and why?
- How could I work with Ben?
- What does Ben’s network look like?
- How do I build something like this?

<!-- end quickstart choices -->

For the full OODA guide, downloadable routes and feedback instructions, use the [Markdown profile](https://benohanlon.md/benohanlon.md) or its [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/benohanlon/ecosystem-operator-collective-public/main/benohanlon.md).
